name: gunship-2
title: Gunship 2
description: A more agile gunship. The engines sit 0.9 m further apart, with the hull and the tank between them, hull above tank, so the mass is closer to the middle; the cannon stands on the wing between the engines' tops, 1.5 m lower than on the Gunship, with the same barrel. The magazine holds half as many shells (15). The rest is as the Gunship: F fires, Q and E fly, three unmanned ships and three asteroids nearby, and every ship has the same material and weld strength. Like the engines, the cannon burns its propellant with a 20× economy.

ui.lookFor: Fly with Q and E; F fires. Gunship 2 turns faster than the Gunship: wider engines, a lower cannon and fewer shells. Each shot kicks the ship back, so aim by turning, fire, then correct. Three unmanned ships drift nearby, the nearest about 15 m off, with three asteroids further out whose gravity bends your shots a little. Hit a tank and it leaks; hit hard enough and parts break off. Try a heavier shell, a bigger charge, a longer barrel or a shorter reload, and turn everyone's strength down or up.
